litem.frameTop.hint:
----HINT----
1. After importing, click “Basic Analysis” manually.
2. First click on “Basic Analysis” will auto-open import window.
3. Do not disable ‘Render’ in Settings unless necessary. Disable 3D rendering for low-end systems.
4. Block IDs and replacement table can use either Chinese or game ID (e.g. 泥土 & minecraft:dirt)
5. Replacement format: oldBlock-newBlock, oldBlock2-newBlock2,...
	‘-’ separates old/new blocks, ‘,’ separates groups. You can mix Chinese and IDs.
	Add block properties after old block (for editing) or after new block (for output).
	All properties must be wrapped in braces {} and use key-value pairs like {"property":"value",...}. All strings must be in quotes!
Example: Furnace{"facing":"west"}-BlastFurnace{"facing":"east"}, OakSlab-OakSlab{"waterlogged":"false"}
Furnaces facing west → Blast furnaces facing east; All Oak slabs → non-waterlogged Oak slabs
